mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 76 degrees and clear near Badger Ridge Middle School. The air quality index is 59, so please take note. We have a beautiful waxing gibbous moon, and the space station will be visible at 10:25 PM, rising in the west over Mount Horeb and moving toward the south over Belleville. The overnight low will be 63 degrees with no rain predicted.

Verona students have finished submitting designs for the I Voted sticker contest, which aims to engage the community in the election process. The public will vote on the top designs from July 28 through August 7, and the winners will see their artwork on stickers handed out at the November election.

There is plenty to do in Verona! We have live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol or live music at Paddy Mac's.
In our weekly police report, on July 13, officers responded to a situation where a 36-year-old Madison man was arrested for his first O-W-I offense after his vehicle became stuck on a rock.
Today's flavor is the Chocolate Volcano. The store is open until 10:30 PM, so there is still plenty of time to head over and enjoy a scoop.
